definitions.explanation: A rough, familiar word for one's older sister, used mainly by men and boys, both to refer to her and to address her. Also a respectful-familiar title for an older woman one looks up to, as in yakuza or delinquent slang.

examples.japanese: {姉貴|あねき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: My big sister lives in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: {姉貴|あねき}、⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧{金|かね}{貸|か}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれない→くれる：00724_kureru⟧?
examples.english: Sis, could you lend me some money?

examples.japanese: {姉貴|あねき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がらなくて→上がる：00615_agaru⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{逆|さか}らえない→逆らう：02106_sakarau⟧。
examples.english: I've never been able to stand up to my big sister, and even now I can't say no to her.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{姉貴|あねき}: my big sister
- {姉貴|あねき}⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧: an older woman who acts as one's big sister

REGISTER:
Masculine and casual. In polite speech one's own sister is ⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧; to address her, ⟦お{姉|ねえ}ちゃん→お姉ちゃん：27278_oneechan⟧ or ⟦お{姉|ねえ}さん→お姉さん：02859_oneesan⟧ are commoner, especially among women.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{兄貴|あにき}→兄貴：11623_aniki⟧: big brother — the male counterpart
- ⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧: older sister (neutral, one's own)
- ⟦お{姉|ねえ}さん→お姉さん：02859_oneesan⟧: older sister (polite; also a young woman)
